scope: Only HEAD-relative changed paths and untracked nonignored paths in the current repository; no parent/global credential directories scanned. Read-only Git; no add/commit/push/delete.
limitations: Pattern matches are candidates, not confirmed credentials; no matched text/value is stored or printed.
Binary files and archives were not searched internally; no claim that they are secret-free.
Existing ignored files and unchanged tracked files are outside requested content scan. Repository .git internals were not traversed.
Run launch nonces are classified separately from service credentials and VS debug access tokens; preserve provenance until root decides backup handling.
Human names, authorized problem data, peer ZIP/Word and project chats are not automatically credentials.
Root may continue writing documents/GUI logs; this is a timestamped snapshot, not a promise that future changes are scanned.
The two preflight report files are generated after candidate enumeration and contain paths/counts only.

followup_debug_token_scan.scope: Values and text withheld; named/argument patterns accept quotes, commas, backslashes and equals separators.

final_candidate_set_delta.scope: Only this generated JSON appeared between completed scan and final file-list refresh; Markdown report is generated next.

internal_nonce_interpretation: 32 files/64 occurrences are project-run launch verification nonces identified by field/argument. They are not automatically classified as external service credentials or VS debug access credentials. Their values are not printed or copied into this report.
